# Maestro 1.1.4
## command palette! (cmd + k)
also some other small things that improve how it feels to use maestro: - [MAE-32: on new message scroll it up to top](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-32/on-new-message-scroll-it-up-to-top) - [MAE-197: remove worked for separator until the appearance of final answer](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-197/remove-worked-for-separator-until-the-appearance-of-final-answer) - [MAE-190: cannot scroll chat when mouse is over code block or html](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-190/cannot-scroll-chat-when-mouse-is-over-code-block-or-html) - [MAE-165: swiftdown visual bug with inline code snippets where the background appears immediately before the animation](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-165/swiftdown-visual-bug-with-inline-code-snippets-where-the-background)
